description: This file contains the implementation of the DefaultSelection class, a Drupal plugin for entity reference selection, including methods for configuration, entity querying, validation, and creation.

classes.name: DefaultSelection
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class implementing entity reference selection with default behavior, including configuration, validation, and entity querying methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the DefaultSelection plugin with necessary services.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Provides default configuration settings for the plugin.

methods.name: buildConfigurationForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for the plugin, allowing admin customization.

methods.name: validateTargetBundles
methods.description: Validates the target_bundles form element, setting NULL if none selected.

methods.name: validateTargetBundlesUpdate
methods.description: Validates the target_bundles_update form element, unsetting its value.

methods.name: elementValidateFilter
methods.description: Filters the value of a form element, removing empty entries.

methods.name: getReferenceableEntities
methods.description: Retrieves entities that can be referenced, optionally matching a search term.

methods.name: countReferenceableEntities
methods.description: Counts the number of referenceable entities matching criteria.

methods.name: validateReferenceableEntities
methods.description: Validates a list of entity IDs to ensure they are referenceable.

methods.name: createNewEntity
methods.description: Creates a new entity of specified type and bundle, assigning owner if applicable.

methods.name: validateReferenceableNewEntities
methods.description: Filters new entities to ensure they match target bundle constraints.

methods.name: buildEntityQuery
methods.description: Builds an entity query to find referenceable entities based on configuration and optional search.

methods.name: reAlterQuery
methods.description: Allows external modules to alter the entity query via tags and metadata.
